Name: Nyapu-Style Fishing Trawler Portrait
Author: earthtosyd
Description:
✦ ABOUT

﻿﻿Replaces Murphy's portrait from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15941]Fishing Trawler: New Horizons[/url] to be used in collaboration with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url].

✦ INSTALLATION

﻿﻿1. Download Nyapu-Style Fishing Trawler Portrait from the FILES tab,

﻿﻿2. Extract the downloaded .zip file into the mod's folder, following the path:

﻿﻿ ﻿ ﻿C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods

﻿﻿﻿ ﻿3. Done!

[color=#ff0000] ﻿NOTE: The following mod is made using Content Patcher and does not require manual file replacement.[/color]

✦ FEATURES

﻿ ﻿With the 2.1.0 update, the following configuration has been added:

﻿Portrait Style
﻿Optionally enable wrinkle overlay.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YxIKVRh.png[/img]
✦ FEEDBACK & SUGGESTIONS

﻿﻿If you have any ideas for additions and improvements, don’t hesitate to drop a comment and share your thoughts!

✦ RECOMMENDED

﻿﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16901]Lad's Fishing Trawler Resprites[/url]
﻿﻿For compatibility, set "Murphy's Portraits" to "Original" in the mod's configuration menu.
﻿
✦ THANK YOU & CREDITS

﻿﻿The art belongs to the original creator, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu]Nyapu[/url].
﻿﻿The mariner's cap is an edited asset originally drawn by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AhCuteArt]AhCuteArt[/url].
﻿The mod, Fishing Trawler: New Horizons, by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PeacefulEnd]PeacefulEnd[/url].
